card.intuition: A tool result is what the harness sends back after executing a tool call - file contents, command output, or an error - and the agent's only view of the environment. It travels to the model in the next provider request, where the model decides what to do with it.
card.analogy: Sensor readings streaming back to a control room: the operator reacts to what the gauge shows on screen, and that reading, not the machine itself, is all the operator can ever see.
card.time_complexity: Every tool call costs an extra model provider request, because the tool result must go back to the model before it can decide what to do next.
card.space_complexity: Results land in the context window in full and stay for the rest of the session, so a few large results - a verbose test log, a generated file read whole - can push the window toward its edge faster than the conversation.
when_to_use: When the agent's picture of your system seems wrong - the tool results in the transcript are where to look
When a large output would flood the context - consider truncation to protect the token budget
When verifying what the model actually saw - the model has no other way to see the environment
When a result says something different from what you know to be true - that is the source of the wrong reasoning
gotchas: The model cannot check the environment behind the result - if output was truncated, silently failed, or denied, it reasons from the error string
Tool results usually form the bulk of a session's context and keep occupying tokens long after they stop being useful
A permission denial arrives as a tool result, so the agent may think it saw a file when it only saw a denial

steps.label: Execute
steps.annotation: The harness runs the command or reads the file named by the tool call.

steps.label: Capture
steps.annotation: The harness captures the outcome: output, file contents, or an error.

steps.label: Append
steps.annotation: The outcome is appended to the conversation context as a message.

steps.label: Send
steps.annotation: The whole context goes to the provider in the next model provider request.

steps.label: Decide
steps.annotation: The model reads the result and decides: another tool call, or a final answer.

exercise.prompt: Simulate the model consuming a tool result: record it in the session context and decide the next action based on the output.
hints: Every tool result stays in the context for the rest of the session
A failing test output is not a final answer - the model tries again
exercise.test_code:
session = {'context': []}
assert decide(session, {'output': 'PASS'}) == 'done'
assert decide(session, {'output': 'FAIL'}) == 'retry'
assert session['context'] == [{'output': 'PASS'}, {'output': 'FAIL'}]
print('PASS')
